Redefining Success.title: Redefining Success
Redefining Success.structure:
Only [a small fraction] of [specific initiatives/individuals] [achieve a desirable outcome].
But you don’t have to follow the [typical definition of success].
Define what success means to you - something you’ll look back on in [time period] with pride.

Promises vs Reality.title: Promises vs Reality
Promises vs Reality.structure:
What [Technology/Product] promised: [Grand promise].
What [Technology/Product] delivered: [Funny, mundane, or ironic reality].
Promises vs Reality.example:
What AI promised: End of manual work.
What AI delivered: A second layer of manual work to double-check the AI.

Turning Point in Life.title: Turning Point in Life
Turning Point in Life.structure: You hit [specific age or milestone], and suddenly [group of people or community] starts [unexpected or stereotypical activity].
Turning Point in Life.example: You turn 30 and the whole squad starts playing pickleball or running half marathons.

Finding Motivation.title: Finding Motivation
Finding Motivation.structure:
Finding motivation can be tough, especially when [specific challenge] feels overwhelming.
Here are a few things that keep me energized and focused: [Practical habit or routine].
What’s your favorite way to push through tough days?
Finding Motivation.example:
Finding motivation can be tough, especially when you’re a creator battling a creative block.
Here are a few things that helped me get back on track:
1. Taking a step back to recharge and reflect - it’s okay to pause.
